answer_1.quote: We consider two tasks: summarization, common in alignment research, and open-ended dialog generation, with substantial real-world relevance... Summarization. The Seahorse dataset contains documents and summaries in six languages... Open-Ended Dialog Generation. We use the OpenAssistant dataset with multilingual, pairwise human-rated chat transcripts.
